description: Search reports by meaning and keyword (pgvector similarity server-side; falls back to summary/description substring if embeddings are unavailable). Returns ranked { results: [{ id, summary, similarity }] }. Read-only. Use to find reports by free text ("checkout flakiness"); use get_similar_bugs to dedupe a known component/bug, or get_recent_reports to list without a query.
